note: RAW SOURCE SCANS, not store elements. Everything here is fetched material a clip can be cut FROM. The asset store (pack/pack.json) only ever holds elements someone has looked at; these are earlier in the chain and carry an explicit verified flag so the difference cannot blur.
verifying: A source is verified by LOOKING at it in PlayCanvas's own viewer: splat-transform emits a self-contained .html from any .sog (npm run splat:view <name>). Never judge a scan through a viewer you have not first pointed at a scene you already trust — a hand-rolled one here rendered the known-good carshop as coloured mush and nearly condemned six good scans.

fetched_unverified.note: Fetched from Hugging Face, which has NO account gate: a public repo serves its files to anyone. The licence is the UPLOADER'S CLAIM, not proof they made the scan — prefer repos where the uploader is plausibly the maker. LOOKED AT in PlayCanvas's own viewer where marked; cabin and stones are good, market is poor, bridge is doubtful. Re-fetch or replace freely.

items.name: cabin
items.seen: a cabin interior at Christmas — tree, TV cabinet, patterned rug, hearth. Real and usable.

items.name: stones
items.seen: painted pebbles on a garden step under flowers. Small subject, clean.

items.name: bridge
items.seen: close, soft and largely featureless from the default camera; needs a proper look before use.

items.name: market
items.seen: soft and smeared; the poorest of the six.

catalogues.note: Seven catalogues tested by hand with real HTTP requests. 'open' means a file came down with no account at all — verified, with byte counts. Nothing here was worked around: where a login is required that is the finding, and a signed-in human does that step.

tested.name: Hugging Face
tested.licence: repo tag, the UPLOADER'S CLAIM not proof of authorship
tested.evidence: files fetched with no account; 13 repos under open licences
tested.fit: mixed test scans; cabin and stones verified good

tested.name: Kaggle
tested.evidence: 802,978 bytes fetched with no account at all; unzipped to a real trained .ply
tested.fit: STRONG — Simon Bethke (our garden scan's author) also publishes here: 'Garage' (old vehicles, CC BY-SA) and 'Botanical Garden - Tropics'. Caveat: some of his Kaggle items are raw COLMAP photos, not finished splats — check the file list first.

tested.name: Zenodo
tested.fit: WEAK — academic and synthetic subjects (lego, hotdog, campus scans); no mills, cottages or mines

tested.name: superspl.at / PlayCanvas
tested.licence: downloads.enabled + downloads.license, the author's own switch
tested.evidence: 401 on GET and POST, every format, even where the author enabled downloads
tested.fit: STRONG — 83 open-licensed matches against the story want-list

tested.name: Sketchfab
tested.evidence: 401 without an API token even for CC-BY downloadable models
tested.fit: BEST SUBJECT MATCH FOUND — Project ETERNAL heritage scans: Constable's House and Christchurch Castle, both CC BY. English cottage and Norman ruin.

tested.name: Polycam
tested.evidence: captures API answers 401; explore page is client-rendered with no embedded JSON; sitemap lists no captures

tested.name: Luma AI
tested.evidence: dashboard is login-gated; api.lumalabs.ai returns a placeholder

catalogues.warning: huggingface.co/cakewalk/splat-data — the repo the popular splat viewers fetch their demos from — carries NO licence tag, and its files are the recognisable Mip-NeRF360 and Tanks-and-Temples research scenes reposted without a rights grant. Do not take from it.
